text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I can't stop thinking about the Special
Carrot
Overload Set that Oguri's
eating...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
But I've got a race coming up, so I can't
eat too
much, right?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: But... it's all I can think about!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Y-you're right... I guess I'll pass for
today...
choice_data_list: 今はバランスの取れた食事が大事！
あとで運動すれば大丈夫！

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Okey dokey! Then I'll make sure to win!
choice_data_list: レースに勝ったら、思いっきり食べよう！

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
You're right! After all, they say it's bad
to never
treat yourself!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
It won't be a problem as long as I burn
the
calories during training!
